info.title: Trickle API
info.description:
Metadata API for Trickle: sessions, users, companies, workers, recipients, bank accounts, payouts, invites, gas sponsorship, judge mode and FX. Money lives on-chain; this API never stores balances.

Sign in by exchanging a Privy access token at `POST /api/v1/sessions`, then send the returned token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Resource endpoints live under `/api/v1`. Errors always use `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`: 400 for unreadable requests, 422 for schema validation failures (one `details` entry per field). List endpoints take `?limit=&cursor=` and return `{ data, nextCursor }`.

post.summary: Sign in with a Privy access token
post.description: Exchanges the access token from Privy (`getAccessToken()` in the web app) for a Trickle session token. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on protected endpoints. The account is keyed to the Privy embedded wallet; 409 `WALLET_NOT_READY` means Privy has not created that wallet yet, so retry shortly.

post.summary: Cash out a transfer to one of my bank accounts (recipient)
post.description:
First transfer mock AUSD from your account to `PAYOUT_ADDRESS` on-chain, then send its hash here. The API checks the receipt (token, sender, recipient, amount), converts at the current USD→IDR rate, and starts a sandbox disbursement. Poll `GET /payouts/:id` until `COMPLETED` or `FAILED`.

One payout per transfer: sending the same hash again returns the first payout (200). Errors: 409 `TX_PENDING` (not mined yet, retry), `PAYOUT_EXISTS` (another account used this hash); 400 `TX_FAILED`, `TX_NOT_A_PAYOUT`; 404 `BANK_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND`; 503 `PAYOUTS_UNAVAILABLE`.

txHash.description: The token transfer from your account to `PAYOUT_ADDRESS`

post.summary: Disbursement status from the payout provider
post.description: Called by the provider, not the web app. Signed with `PAYOUT_WEBHOOK_SECRET`: `x-payout-timestamp` is Unix seconds (at most 5 minutes old) and `x-payout-signature` is `sha256=` + hex HMAC-SHA256 of `<timestamp>.<raw body>`. Idempotent: a payout that already finished keeps its status.

post.description: WORKER invite: the user joins the company (`/workers`). RECIPIENT invite: the user becomes a recipient of the worker (`/recipients`).

post.summary: Fund the signed-in account's gas, once per address
post.description:
Called by the web app before the first transaction (e.g. a withdrawal), so users never hold or see MON. Open to any signed-in account, including brand-new judge mode accounts. Idempotent: calling again returns the original drip (200). `SENT` means broadcast; wait for the receipt of `txHash` before relying on the balance.

Errors: 429 `DRIP_IP_LIMIT` (per IP per day), `DRIP_DAILY_LIMIT` (all users), `RATE_LIMITED`; 503 `DRIP_UNAVAILABLE` (no treasury configured), `DRIP_TREASURY_EMPTY`; 502 `DRIP_FAILED` (safe to retry).

get.summary: Treasury balance and drip usage, for monitoring

post.description: Deprecated: use `POST /gas-drips`. Kept until the web app moves over; same behaviour.

get.description: Deprecated: use `GET /gas-drips/status`. Kept until the web app moves over; same behaviour.

post.summary: Judge mode: start a real testnet salary stream to the signed-in account
post.description: The demo employer streams a small amount of mock AUSD to the caller on Monad testnet, so a visitor sees the worker balance grow without a faucet or a wallet. Open to any signed-in account, no role needed. One stream per account: calling again returns the first one (200). Limited per IP and per day (429 `DEMO_IP_LIMIT`, `DEMO_DAILY_LIMIT`).

get.summary: Demo employer gas and usage, for monitoring during judging

get.summary: USD to IDR exchange rate (display and estimates only)
get.description: Cached for 600 seconds. Falls back to the last good rate, then to a static rate, and says which one it is. Any signed-in account (PLAN §6.3: E, W, R).

get.description: Deprecated: use `GET /fx-rates/usd-idr` with a session. Kept public until the web app moves over. Cached for 600 seconds. Falls back to the last good rate, then to a static rate, and says which one it is.
